text.title: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) forbade qaza‘ (shaving part of one's head and leaving other parts unshaven)
text.text: Ibn ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) forbade qaza‘ (shaving part of one's head and leaving other parts unshaven).
text.explanation:
The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) forbade shaving part of one's head and leaving other parts unshaven.

This prohibition is general and applies to all males, children and adults. As for women, they should not shave their heads.
text.benefits: The Hadīth shows the Shariah's care for people's appearance.

arabic.title: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن القزع
arabic.text: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنِ الْقَزَعِ.
arabic.explanation:
نَهى النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عن حَلْقِ بَعض شَعر الرأس وتركِ بعضه.

والنهيُ عامٌّ للذكور الصغار والكبار، أما المرأةُ فليس لها أن تَحلِقَ شعرَ رأسِها.
